note: Inyo NF campground in open sagebrush on Whitney Portal Rd ~6 mi W of Lone Pine, along Lone Pine Creek, with little shade; the Whitney Portal National Recreation Trail starts at its west end. Bear lockers at every site; showers 8 mi up the road at the Portal Store. --Claude
summary: Lone Pine (Inyo NF): $34 (2027), reservable on recreation.gov Apr 16 - Oct 23 2027 with sites 010/037 first-come, 14-night limit, $10 extra vehicle. max_rig_ft corrected 50 -> 40 (the 50 ft is a tent site). Creekside kept: sites 013/014/017/020 sit at the edge of the creek's riparian strip. Phone should be the Inyo page's (760) 876-6200.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside KEPT, checked on Esri imagery with rec.gov site points. Lone Pine Creek (a stream a few metres wide) runs in a willow/pine strip along the north edge of the loop; sites 013 (36.59815,-118.18435), 014 (36.59821,-118.18403), 017 (36.59825,-118.18372) and 020 (36.59836,-118.18322) sit at the edge of that tree band, the channel ~25-40 m north under canopy. The bank itself is not visible from above; no grade or wall shows in the imagery. Not a candidate for any higher tier.

STATUS: the Inyo NF page carries a 'Site Closed' banner (read 2026-11-26), consistent with the seasonal close after mid-October; the alerts page has no closure order for it and recreation.gov sells 2027 nights from Apr 16. Left open, season recorded. Recheck the banner in spring.

CONFLICT (FS vs rec.gov): FS page says '42 Single campsites, 1 Double site, and 1 Walkin Group site'; the recreation.gov catalog has 28 sites (23 standard RV/tent, 3 walk-to, 1 tent-only, 1 group). rec.gov trusted; sites.total not written.

SITES: max_rig_ft 50 -> 40. The stored 50 came from tent-only site 018; standard sites top out at 40 ft (030, 034, 037), matching the FS 'Sites up to 40 feet long'. 20 of 23 standard sites take 23 ft+ (001 21 ft, 017 22 ft, 020 16 ft do not).
PHONE: 760-873-2400 -> 760-876-6200 (the Inyo NF campground page lists 'Phone: (760) 876-6200'; 760-873-2400 is the forest supervisor's office). recreation.gov's facility phone is 760-937-6070.
ACCESS: Whitney Portal Rd is paved to the campground; no RV/trailer warning on either page.
